notes.title: Update 1.002.32
notes.content:
For this update I’ve focused on the conveyor system. The changes are:
[list]
    [*]Conveyor belts no longer overwrite machines - you cannot place a conveyor belt where there is already a machine.
    [*]You can place a single tile conveyor belt - depending on the direction of drag you can create a horizontal, vertical or corner belt.
    [*]You can right-click a conveyor belt tile to change the orientation of the belt. Only orientations that connect to adjacent tiles with connection points are shown.
    [*]If a conveyor belt end is next to a machine connection point it will connect to the machine.
[/list]


Thank you to everyone who has provided suggestions and feedback.

tags.feature: Conveyor belts no longer overwrite machines - you cannot place a conveyor belt where there is already a machine.
You can place a single tile conveyor belt - depending on the direction of drag you can create a horizontal, vertical or corner belt.
You can right-click a conveyor belt tile to change the orientation of the belt. Only orientations that connect to adjacent tiles with connection points are shown.
If a conveyor belt end is next to a machine connection point it will connect to the machine.
